title: Piperine targets SOAT1 to inhibit the progression of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma via ferroptosis.
authors: Wei, Chengming; Shi, Meina; Wei, Liujiao; Wei, Caituan
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究胡椒碱靶向SOAT1通过铁死亡抑制食管鳞癌进展，虽含分子对接但核心为药物-蛋白作用与肿瘤机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) is a major contributor to cancer-associated mortality worldwide. Therefore, there is an urgent need to identify novel therapeutic targets and treatment modalities for this disease. Piperine, a natural alkaloid, has been shown to possess notable anticancer properties. However, the anticancer efficacy of piperine in ESCC and its underlying molecular mechanisms remain unclear. PURPOSE: This study aimed to investigate the anticancer effect and molecular mechanism of piperine in ESCC. METHODS: To evaluate the anticancer potential of piperine against ESCC, a series of experiments was conducted. These included key gene knockdown, CCK-8 assays, colony formation tests, molecular docking studies, bioinformatics analyses, Western blotting, and real-time PCR arrays. RESULTS: Piperine inhibited cell proliferation, migration, and invasion. Importantly, piperine was identified as a potential Sterol O-acyltransferase 1 (SOAT1) inhibitor. Interestingly, piperine targets SOAT1 to enhance ferroptosis and inhibit cell viability. Furthermore, piperine targets SOAT1 to synergistically enhance the anticancer effects of cisplatin in ESCC. Further data analysis showed that inhibiting SOAT1 increased KLF4-induced ALOX12B expression by decreasing the PI3K-AKT pathway. Finally, in vivo studies demonstrated that the SOAT1 inhibitor piperine hindered tumor growth in mice without altering body weight. CONCLUSION: This study is the first to demonstrate that piperine targets SOAT1 to enhance ferroptosis by inhibiting the PI3K-AKT axis and upregulating the expression of KLF4/ALOX12B. This study strongly emphasizes the potential of piperine as a promising clinical therapeutic candidate for ESCC.
abstract_zh: 背景：食管鳞状细胞癌（ESCC）是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一。因此，迫切需要寻找针对该疾病的新型治疗靶点和治疗方式。胡椒碱作为一种天然生物碱，已被证明具有显著的抗癌特性。然而，胡椒碱在ESCC中的抗癌效果及其潜在分子机制仍不清楚。目的：本研究旨在探讨胡椒碱在ESCC中的抗癌作用及分子机制。方法：为评估胡椒碱对ESCC的抗癌潜力，进行了一系列实验，包括关键基因敲低、CCK-8实验、集落形成实验、分子对接研究、生物信息学分析、Western blotting和实时PCR阵列。结果：胡椒碱抑制了细胞增殖、迁移和侵袭。重要的是，胡椒碱被鉴定为潜在的甾醇O-酰基转移酶1（SOAT1）抑制剂。有趣的是，胡椒碱通过靶向SOAT1增强铁死亡并抑制细胞活力。此外，胡椒碱靶向SOAT1协同增强顺铂在ESCC中的抗癌效果。进一步的数据分析显示，抑制SOAT1通过降低PI3K-AKT通路增加了KLF4诱导的ALOX12B表达。最后，体内研究表明，SOAT1抑制剂胡椒碱在未改变小鼠体重的情况下阻碍了肿瘤生长。结论：本研究首次证明胡椒碱通过靶向SOAT1，抑制PI3K-AKT轴并上调KLF4/ALOX12B表达来增强铁死亡。该研究强烈强调了胡椒碱作为ESCC有前景的临床治疗候选药物的潜力。
